name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan said on 10 Nov China is running carrier-led area-denial drills in the Pacific; G7 voiced concern on 12 Nov
state: On 10 Nov Taiwan's defence minister Wellington Koo said China is conducting area-denial drills in the Western Pacific involving a carrier group, and warned they threaten regional peace (ThePrint, citing Reuters). G7 foreign ministers said on 12 Nov that China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability (Taipei Times). No blockade, quarantine, military clash or severed diplomatic channel was found as of 14 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Shipping, flights and supply chains through the Taiwan Strait and western Pacific are exposed if drills widen. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA naval drills near Taiwan (carrier group, 10 Nov); no blockade, quarantine or clash

sources.title: ThePrint (Reuters) — Taiwan says China is conducting 'area denial' drills in Western Pacific
Taipei Times — G7 foreign ministers say China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
